observations.behavior: Adds a new environment variable and documentation for revealing the seeded local development API key.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Settings page to display the plaintext value of the deterministic local-dev API key, which is otherwise hidden. This requires the backend reveal gate and the frontend UI change.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation explaining the new reveal behavior and its dependency on the reveal gate.
observations.code_quote: That dev key's full value is also shown in [Settings > Personal API keys](http://localhost:8010/settings/user-api-keys), so you can copy it without rerunning the command.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the workflow for developers using the reveal gate, while also warning that this is not available for other keys.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for a copy-to-clipboard component, which is used to display the revealed key.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the frontend component needed to display and copy the revealed key, while also warning that this is not available for other keys.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Django setting option, `ALLOW_DEV_API_KEY_REVEAL`, which, when enabled, allows the full value of a seeded dev personal API key to be revealed in the UI.
observations.posthog_connection: This could enable a developer-facing debugging or recovery feature where a temporary API key is displayed, potentially useful for account recovery or debugging, but the implementation and safeguards are not visible in this hunk.
